result.topic_en: Draft introduction to Riemann's 1855 work on the hypergeometric (P-) functions: the second-order linear differential equation with independent variable in the first degree, Euler's and Gauss's results, and the characteristic properties (behaviour at the branch points 0, 1, ∞) of the solutions of the normalised equation (2).

methods.what: Second-order linear ODE in d/dlog x with x entering only in two dimensions (Euler's form)
Series solution in powers of x with exponents in arithmetic progression (Euler), identified with Gauss's hypergeometric series
methods.quote: nach Potenzen von $x$ entwickeln lasse, deren Exponenten eine arithmetische Reihe mit der Differenz $\lambda$ bilden

methods.what: Normalised hypergeometric equation (2) obtained by substitution
Any three branches satisfy a linear relation with constant coefficients
Local exponents at x=0, ∞, 1 and decomposition into two components with power behaviour
